title: 雪岭晨光
subtitle: 晨光掠过积雪山峰，薄云在山脊间缓慢流动。
subtitleEn: Morning light brushes across snowy peaks as thin clouds drift along the ridge.

title: 粉雪余晖
subtitle: 粉紫霞光照亮雪原与松林，雪花轻轻飘落。
subtitleEn: Rose-violet twilight illuminates a snowy pine forest while soft flakes fall.

title: 雪湖夜色
subtitle: 静默雪湖映着冷月微光，远山与小岛消隐在雾雪里。
subtitleEn: A quiet winter lake reflects cold moonlight as distant peaks fade into snow and mist.

title: 星河之心
subtitle: 璀璨星系在深空中缓慢旋转，光芒从宇宙核心涌出。
subtitleEn: A luminous galaxy turns through deep space, glowing from its brilliant core.

title: 溪畔篝火
subtitle: 溪水在夜色中穿过岩石，篝火为安静河岸留下温暖光影。
subtitleEn: A campfire warms the quiet riverbank while water moves between dark stones.

title: 霓虹方阵
subtitle: 蓝红几何方柱错落上升，构成富有纵深的赛博空间。
subtitleEn: Blue and red geometric columns rise into a layered cybernetic cityscape.

title: 黑金绒夜
subtitle: 古典沙发与黑金造型交织，营造华丽而克制的复古氛围。
subtitleEn: A black-and-gold portrait set against an ornate sofa creates restrained vintage glamour.

title: 蓝海花舟
subtitle: 一叶白色小舟载着鲜花，在清澈蓝海上泛起温柔涟漪。
subtitleEn: A white flower boat drifts across clear blue water, leaving gentle ripples behind.

title: 暗夜剑姬
subtitle: 银白长裙与古典剑锋在暗色宫廷里构成冷艳画面。
subtitleEn: A silver-dressed swordswoman poses in a dark ornate chamber with cool elegance.

title: 甜心镜头
subtitle: 粉白发色与闪钻妆造靠近镜头，带来充满活力的舞台感。
subtitleEn: Pink-white hair and sparkling makeup fill the frame with playful stage energy.

title: 星链少女
subtitle: 黑灰格纹造型配以金属星链，展现利落的千禧年时尚。
subtitleEn: Plaid styling and metallic star chains create a sharp Y2K fashion portrait.

title: 霓虹水镜
subtitle: 晶莹水面映出紫蓝星眸，光线如液态霓虹般流动。
subtitleEn: Violet-blue eyes shimmer beneath liquid neon reflections and crystalline light.

title: 云下青原
subtitle: 洁白云朵漂过鲜绿草原，微风让平静的地平线轻轻起伏。
subtitleEn: White clouds cross a vivid green meadow as a breeze ripples toward the horizon.

title: 富士霞光
subtitle: 富士山沉入橙金晚霞，山影在幽暗前景中层层展开。
subtitleEn: Mount Fuji settles into orange-gold dusk above layered shadowed ridges.

title: 风过青丘
subtitle: 夏日云群从青绿山坡上掠过，远处白鸟与风同行。
subtitleEn: Summer clouds sweep over green hills while distant birds travel with the wind.

title: 雾海断崖
subtitle: 深色海浪拍击连绵崖壁，远处的陆地逐渐消失在海雾中。
subtitleEn: Dark waves meet long sea cliffs that gradually disappear into coastal mist.

title: 卡芙卡·夜窗
subtitle: 卡芙卡倚坐城市高窗，紫色夜光与天际线在身后闪烁。
subtitleEn: Kafka rests beside a high-rise window as violet city lights shimmer behind her.

title: 柚叶·盛夏海岸
subtitle: 柚叶在蓝天海浪间举起水枪，溅起明快透亮的夏日水花。
subtitleEn: Yuzuha raises a water blaster between blue sky and surf in a bright summer splash.

title: 星瞳幻光
subtitle: 粉紫晶光围绕少女面庞，星河般的瞳色在暗处闪耀。
subtitleEn: Crystal violet light surrounds an anime portrait with galaxy-bright eyes.

title: 苍蓝之刃
subtitle: 刀锋横贯苍蓝面庞，冰晶光点在雨夜中划出冷冽轨迹。
subtitleEn: A blade crosses an azure gaze while icy sparks trace the rain-dark scene.

title: 蝶落星眸
subtitle: 蓝色蝶影与星光落入眼眸，柔和面庞沉浸在梦幻光斑里。
subtitleEn: Blue butterflies and starlight gather in a soft, dreamlike anime gaze.

title: 熔火武士
subtitle: 装甲武士立于霓虹雨巷，橙红能量像熔岩一样流过机械躯体。
subtitleEn: An armored samurai stands in a neon alley as molten energy courses through the suit.

title: 雨夜便利店
subtitle: 便利店灯牌映照潮湿街面，黑衣身影在子夜霓虹中停留。
subtitleEn: Convenience-store lights reflect on wet pavement around a solitary midnight figure.

title: 花野微风
subtitle: 暖阳穿过花野，白裙少女在柔焦草地中沐浴微风。
subtitleEn: Warm sunlight crosses a flower meadow around a girl in a white dress.

title: 晨光厨房
subtitle: 清晨阳光洒入白色厨房，安静人像与家居空间温柔相融。
subtitleEn: Morning sun fills a white kitchen, creating a soft and intimate home portrait.

title: 站台来风
subtitle: 列车驶近的瞬间卷起长发，站台上的身影沉入电影般深景。
subtitleEn: An arriving train lifts her hair as the platform falls into cinematic depth.

title: 古堡回眸
subtitle: 古董镜框与暖色烛灯包围黑发人像，留下幽静复古的回眸。
subtitleEn: Antique mirrors and warm candlelight frame a quiet, vintage glance.

title: 午夜琴声
subtitle: 黑色礼服与钢琴在暖灯下相遇，红毯房间流动着夜曲般的光。
subtitleEn: A black gown and grand piano meet beneath warm light in a room shaped like a nocturne.

title: 夜车红酒
subtitle: 暖黄车灯照亮红酒与侧脸，老式车厢保留着私密夜色。
subtitleEn: Warm car lights illuminate wine and a profile inside a private vintage cabin.

title: 雪夜金克丝
subtitle: 蓝发金克丝伏在雪地，橙色灯火与冷蓝夜色相互映照。
subtitleEn: Blue-haired Jinx rests in the snow beneath the contrast of amber lanterns and cold night.

title: 霓虹天台
subtitle: 银色外套反射高楼灯海，城市天台上浮动着冷色未来感。
subtitleEn: A silver jacket catches the skyline glow on a cool futuristic rooftop.

title: 金色舞步
subtitle: 金色流苏与水面倒影随舞步摇曳，整个舞台如同液态星光。
subtitleEn: Golden fringe and reflections sway with the dancer like liquid starlight.

title: 镜面舞厅
subtitle: 银色礼服在霓虹镜面间闪耀，流光与倒影构成夜店节奏。
subtitleEn: A silver dress gleams between neon mirrors, reflections moving to a nightclub rhythm.

title: 午后慢时光
subtitle: 柔和日光穿过窗帘，乳白色室内定格一段安静午后。
subtitleEn: Soft light passes through curtains, holding a quiet afternoon in warm ivory tones.

title: 肴·海岛假日
subtitle: 肴在热带海面与鱼群之间挥杆，展开色彩明快的岛屿假日。
subtitleEn: Mauxir casts a line above tropical water and bright schools of fish.

title: 缪斯冲刺·幻想乡
subtitle: 高饱和色彩中的东方角色群像，呈现音游般明快跳跃的节奏。
subtitleEn: A vivid Touhou ensemble bursts with the bright rhythm of an arcade music game.

title: 银翼机械少女
subtitle: 银蓝配色的机械少女置身暗色装置间，兼具冷艳与未来感。
subtitleEn: A silver-blue android stands among dark machinery with a cool futuristic presence.

title: 光影午休
subtitle: 百叶窗的光影落在床面，绿色帷幔与黑色人像构成安静私密的午休。
subtitleEn: Striped window light crosses a quiet bed framed by deep green drapery.

title: 湖畔晨雾
subtitle: 淡粉天光照进芦苇与湖面，白裙身影在晨雾里宁静停留。
subtitleEn: Pale dawn reaches reeds and still water around a figure in white.

title: 迈尔斯·霓虹坠落
subtitle: 迈尔斯穿越高饱和霓虹城市，自由坠落的瞬间充满动势。
subtitleEn: Miles dives through a saturated neon city in a kinetic moment of freefall.

title: 云海列车
subtitle: 复古车窗外铺开粉蓝云海，车厢像驶入一场安静的梦。
subtitleEn: A vintage train window opens onto pink-blue clouds and a quiet dreamlike journey.

title: 钢铁与暗骑
subtitle: 钢铁侠与蝙蝠侠在火光前对峙，金属面甲映出紧张战意。
subtitleEn: Iron Man and Batman face one another against firelit smoke and armored reflections.

title: 赤雨暗骑
subtitle: 蝙蝠侠的黑色轮廓立于赤红雨幕，画面简洁而富有压迫感。
subtitleEn: Batman stands as a dark silhouette in red rain, stark and imposing.

title: 海棠晴空
subtitle: 粉红海棠在清透蓝天下摇曳，花瓣与阳光交织成春日片段。
subtitleEn: Pink begonias sway beneath a clear sky, petals glowing in spring sunlight.

title: 吞星巨影
subtitle: 巨大黑洞吞没周围光线，炽热吸积盘在绝对黑暗中旋转。
subtitleEn: A colossal black hole bends light as its fiery accretion disk turns in absolute darkness.

title: 蓝色奇点
subtitle: 蓝白能量环绕深黑奇点，宇宙时空如漩涡般向内收束。
subtitleEn: Blue-white energy circles a dark singularity as spacetime folds inward.

title: 雨夜 S13
subtitle: 日产 Silvia S13 停在霓虹雨街，动漫少女与车灯倒影共同点亮夜色。
subtitleEn: A Nissan Silvia S13 and anime girl glow together on a rain-soaked neon street.

title: 松林暮雾
subtitle: 暮色雾气淹没层叠松林，远山在深蓝云层下若隐若现。
subtitleEn: Twilight mist settles over layered pines beneath deep blue mountain clouds.

title: 金字塔来客
subtitle: 落日沙漠中，未知飞行器停在金字塔前，古代与未来相遇。
subtitleEn: An unknown craft rests before a pyramid at sunset, joining antiquity with the future.

title: 赛博跃动少女
subtitle: 霓虹绿黄线条围绕跃动少女，画面融合漫画分镜与赛博音浪。
subtitleEn: Neon green and yellow lines surround a leaping girl in a cyber-comic pulse.

title: 真纪真·龙纹武士
subtitle: 真纪真在赤金背景前持刃而立，龙纹与黑色飞沫强化东方武士感。
subtitleEn: Makima stands armed against red-gold light, framed by dragon motifs and black fragments.

title: 上官婉儿·林间侠影
subtitle: 上官婉儿戴竹笠立于翠绿林间，古风衣袂与柔和天光交叠。
subtitleEn: Shangguan Wan'er stands beneath a woven hat in soft green forest light.

title: 月面引力环
subtitle: 宇航员仰望红蓝引力环，黑洞在月面地平线上扭曲时空。
subtitleEn: An astronaut watches a red-blue gravity ring warp spacetime above the lunar horizon.

title: 比利·赤色通缉
subtitle: 比利持双枪立于赤色海报背景，黑白装甲呈现强烈漫画感。
subtitleEn: Billy poses with twin guns against a red poster backdrop in bold graphic style.

title: 雷电将军·深海
subtitle: 雷电将军的紫发在深海中舒展，水泡与鱼影绕过白色礼服。
subtitleEn: Raiden Shogun's violet hair drifts underwater among bubbles, fish and white fabric.

title: 琥珀眼小黑猫
subtitle: 圆滚滚的小黑猫从蓝色毯边探出脑袋，琥珀色大眼充满好奇。
subtitleEn: A round black kitten peeks over a blue blanket with huge curious amber eyes.

title: 紫眸花影·静态
subtitle: 淡紫花瓣飘过少女面庞，微光在深色发丝与眼眸间停留。
subtitleEn: Pale violet petals pass a girl's face, catching softly in dark hair and eyes.

title: 紫眸花影·动态
subtitle: 淡紫花瓣在少女周围缓慢飘动，微光为深色人像增添安静生命感。
subtitleEn: Pale violet petals drift around a dark-haired portrait in soft, living light.
